description: Ports: Commercial and Ferry is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Marine Renewable Energy Ireland (MaREI). This data shows the location of commercial ports (including ferry) around the Republic of Ireland. It also includes specific data pertaining to the volume of traffic over the period 1999 to 2014, as well as the tonnage of goods handled between 2000 and 2012. Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Marine Renewable Energy Ireland (MaREI). Its tags are environment. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
